newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen moving higher in early trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen moving higher in early trading.

text.p: U.S. stocks were expected to move higher in early trading on Monday, bolstered by steady bonds, firm overseas markets and a strong dollar, analysts said.
"It looks like a steady opening and then we'll pick our way through the remnants of third quarter earnings," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities. "It's going to be a scattered day."
Investors were likely to hold off on radical moves ahead of a week larded with important economic data, climaxing with Friday's October jobs data.
